_why: Single source for the party game rentals line (owner-approved 2026-10-13; pricing v2 and the Giant Uno / Grab the Mic swap owner-approved 2026-10-14). scripts/generators/build_rentals_page.js renders /rentals/ from this file; docs/listings/facebook-marketplace.md and facebook-page.md quote the same rates and scripts/validators/validate_rentals_page.js holds them to it. Images under assets/rentals/ are AI placeholders (Workers AI flux-1-schnell, free allowance) until real photos replace them.

rates._note: Flat per game: $40 for a 24-hour day, $60 for a weekend (Friday delivery, Monday pickup).

games.name: Giant Connect Four
games.blurb: Four-in-a-row at yard scale. Big enough for kids and adults to play standing up.
games.alt: Black father and daughter dropping red and yellow discs into a four-foot giant connect four game at a Memphis backyard party

games.name: Cornhole Set
games.blurb: Two regulation boards and eight bags. Two sets available for a tournament.
games.alt: Black woman tossing a bean bag at a wooden cornhole board on a green lawn at a backyard party

games.name: Giant Tumble Tower
games.blurb: The giant block-stacking game. 54 wooden blocks that stack to about five feet before it falls.
games.alt: Two Black boys sliding a block from a giant wooden tumble tower on a backyard lawn at a party

games.name: Giant Yard Pong
games.blurb: Twelve buckets and balls for a lawn-sized pong game.
games.alt: Black adult friends tossing a ball toward white buckets set up for giant yard pong on a lawn

games.name: Ladder Toss
games.blurb: Two ladders and six bolas. Easy to learn, good for every age at the party.
games.alt: Black grandfather tossing a bola at a ladder toss frame while his grandchildren cheer on a backyard lawn

games.name: Giant Uno
games.blurb: Oversized Uno cards, same rules as the original. Play on a table or spread out on the lawn.
games.alt: Black family and friends on a picnic blanket on a backyard lawn holding up oversized red, yellow, green and blue cards for a giant Uno game

games.name: Giant Checkers
games.blurb: A four-by-four-foot mat with oversized pieces. Works on a lawn, a porch or indoors.
games.alt: Black mother and her young son kneeling on a giant checkers mat on a backyard lawn, moving oversized black checker pieces

games.name: Grab the Mic
games.blurb: The Lucky Egg tabletop singing party game. Flip a word card, and the first player to grab the foam mic and sing a lyric with that word scores. Our rain-plan game.
games.alt: Black friends laughing around a party table while a woman holds a microphone mid-song, a stack of word cards on the table

games.name: Giant Color Stack
games.size: 2 ft tall, 5 poles and rings in 4 colors, ages 6+
games.blurb: A two-foot color-sorting stacking puzzle: slide the sky blue, lime green, yellow and pink rings onto five poles until every pole is one color. Two sets for head-to-head races.
games.alt: Black mother and young children sliding sky blue, lime green, yellow and pink rings onto the light-blue poles of two giant color stack sets side by side on a backyard party table

hero.alt: Black family reunion in a Memphis backyard with a giant connect four, a cornhole board and a giant tumble tower set up on the lawn, balloons and a party table behind
